description: Evidence story fresh state and preflight: two clauses in the /prd evidence-story bullets.

userStories.title: Require fresh state and a preflight in the evidence story
acceptanceCriteria: In `.agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` § Stories, the bullet for a server, CLI, or API change states this rule. The transcript runs each command through the entry point that a user types, for example `pnpm <script> <flags>`. The run starts from fresh state with at least one input path that does not exist yet. The story creates a new temp path for that input and deletes no existing data.

In the same section, the bullet for a live or local resource states this rule. Before the story creates a live resource, the story runs one read-only check that costs nothing, through the same path that the resource uses. If the check fails, the story sets `blocked` and creates nothing.
`CHANGELOG.md` has an `[Unreleased]` entry that links the task issue.
userStories.description: As a plan author, I want stricter evidence-story rules so that evidence catches first-run bugs and live spend waits for a working path.
userStories.notes: 1-2 executed by advisor read-back of the diff: entry point, fresh state with a missing input on a new temp path, and a no-cost read-only preflight that sets blocked. 3 reasoned: CHANGELOG entry links #1546. 4 executed: ste-check no findings. 5 executed: link-providers --check Providers OK. 6 executed: git diff --check exit 0.
